title: Script with many disabled steps
description: Unused-code rule — scripts with five or more disabled steps. Disabled steps are commented-out code that clutters the script and confuses readers.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Piles of disabled steps are dead code kept "just in case"; version control is the right home for that.
rule.remediation: Delete the disabled steps (they live in your backups / VCS if needed).
